notes: SMS capture now has an AI fallback for banks without a dedicated verified template (previously only ICICI/SBI were fully covered). When the fast offline regex parser can't read a message from a real bank sender, it's now sent to AI as a second attempt before falling back to Needs Review - should meaningfully improve capture on phones using other banks. A history re-scan on a phone with lots of previously-unparsed messages may take longer the first time.
